title: Lakebase now supports PCI-DSS and HITRUST in all AWS regions
body: Lakebase is now PCI-DSS and HITRUST compliant in all AWS regions where it is available, for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled. Previously, this support was limited to the `us-east-1` region on AWS. See [Data protection](/aws/en/oltp/projects/data-protection).
